ObjectName.value: Avocado, milk, condensed milk and ice smoothies - Amazing Chef food processor

Categories.value: Taken with Casio Exilim EX-Z850|Food processors|Avocado as food|Flickr images reviewed by trusted users|Beverages from Australia|Milk in Australia|Leek-based food|Photographs by Avlxyz|Condensed milk-based food|Smoothies in Australia|Glasses of smoothie|Avocado dishes of Australia

ImageDescription.value:
Amazing Chef food processor unboxing

Rayson found this on sale online for only AUD1 + AUD14.95 shipping. Bargain!

We'll see if it is any good.

Amazhing Chef food processor - Global Shop Direct

Update 2008.05.14: We tried it last night with avocado smoothies and chopping up some garlic and preserved lemon to make a fish marinade and it passed quite happily. The results was a slightly chunky marinade, probably because there wasn't enough to fill the blades, confirming my theory that good blenders have conical bottoms to cause the contents to collect close to the blade.

The Amazing Chef performed quite well with the cauliflower puree that filled the capsule to three quarters full.

We even had a few cubes of ice in the avocado smoothie and it managed to crush it all, no choking or sputtering. :)

The cups/capsules are polycarbonte, I think. Microwave and dishwasher safe. A quick rinse sorted them out mostly. The screw on blades is a bit annoying though. It takes more effort than most click-on blender lids. And the sillicone seals are a bit finicky to position. Not sure how the after sales support is for things like seals etc. My mum always raves about her Prestige pressure cooker that is 35yo and she can still find seals for it!

Photos: - Amazing Chef - in the box - Amazing Chef - unboxed - Blending garlic, preserved lemon, leek - Blended garlic, preserved lemon, leek marinade - Cauliflower puree

- Avocado, milk, condensed milk and ice smoothies

pages.title: File:Street Foods During Sinulog Chicken wings Inasal.jpg

ObjectName.value: Street Foods During Sinulog Chicken wings Inasal

Categories.value: Sinulog Festival|Street food in the Philippines|Self-published work|Chicken wings as food

ImageDescription.value: Chicken wings inasal is a popular street food during the Sinulog Festival, especially for those looking for flavorful and satisfying snacks. Inasal refers to a type of grilled chicken that is marinated in a mixture of vinegar, calamansi, soy sauce, garlic, and other seasonings, giving it a distinct tangy and savory taste. The chicken wings are grilled to perfection, often served hot off the grill, with a smoky flavor and crispy skin. Vendors can be found selling chicken wings inasal at various spots around Cebu, especially near parade routes and crowded areas where festival-goers gather. This delicious street food is often served with a side of dipping sauces, adding to its appeal as a tasty and filling snack during the lively Sinulog celebration.
